hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.mjs$'; then output=$(node --check "$f" 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Syntax error in $f:\\n$output\"}}"; fi; fi; }
